newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z)- Sept 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Current Australian Takeovers (P to Z)- Sept 3.

text.p: TERMS: A$2.40 cash per share, to take the form of a cash payment of A$2.30 together with a 10 cent fully franked special dividend to be declared by the offeree.

NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire all the issued capital of the offeree. Offer conditional upon 90 percent acceptance. Directors recommend shareholders accept the offer in the absence of a higher bid. Offeror is entitled to 89.61 percent of the target's capital.
TERMS: Four shares in the offeror for each share held and three shares in the offeror for every two options held.

NOTES: Offeror proposes to acquire all the issued capital of the offeree. The offer will be conditional upon necessary regulatory approvals in Canada and Australia and the approval of Mineral Resources shareholders.
TERMS: A$4 cash and 60 pre-consolidation Westgold shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares or 100 Westgold pre-consolidation shares for every 100 Ramsgate shares held.
NOTES: Westgold is entitled to 55.66 percent of Ramsgate. Directors recommend shareholders reject the offer. Offeror will not proceed with compulsory acquisition. The offer has now closed.
TERMS: Four Capital shares for every one Stirling share and is conditional on minimum acceptances of 30 percent of Stirling shares.
NOTES: Capital is now entitled to 32.62 percent of Stirling's issued capital. Independent Stirling directors have advised shareholders to reject the offer
TERMS: Three GUD shares for every eight Sunbeam shares conditional on 90 percent acceptance. On July 9, offer increased to one share in the offeror and 54 cents cash for every three Sunbeam shares.
NOTES: GUD is now entitled to 82.01 percent of Sunbeam's capital. Sunbeam directors advise shareholders to either sell shares on-market or accept the offer.
TERMS: A$2.30 cash per share ex-dividend and 15 cents per option.
NOTES: Directors recommend shareholders not sell their shares pending further advice. Offeror is now entitled to 13.74 percent of the offer.

TERMS: Eight cents cash per share NOTES: Offer is conditional on 90 percent acceptance. Directors advise shareholders to take no action pending further advice. On Augsut 22, directors advise that they will not be proceeding with the offer.

NOTES: Offer conditional on 90 percent acceptance and the All Ordinaries index not falling below 2000 points. Directors advise shareholders to reject the offer. Offeror is entitled to 5.02 percent of offeree.
